remarks:
Create the Country Estate You’ve Been Dreaming Of! Discover 10.07 acres of beautiful, private land in the Town of Newstead, offering the rare combination of highly desirable Clarence Central Schools and the lower property taxes of a Newstead address.
This picturesque parcel provides a wonderful balance of open space and wooded areas, offering privacy, natural beauty, and plenty of room to create something truly your own. Whether your vision is a stunning custom home surrounded by nature, an equestrian property, a private recreational retreat, or simply a peaceful place to enjoy the outdoors, this property offers the space and setting to make it possible.
Enjoy the freedom to explore your own acreage with opportunities for trails, hiking, wildlife watching, hunting, or ATV recreation. The peaceful, park-like surroundings create a private escape while still keeping you close to the conveniences of everyday life.
Public water, electric, telephone, cable, and high-speed internet are available at the road, providing an excellent foundation for building your future home.
Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, golf courses, and other amenities, with an easy commute to Buffalo, Rochester, and Batavia, this property gives you the best of country living without sacrificing convenience.
10.07 acres of privacy, nature, and possibility—build your dream home, create your own retreat, and enjoy a lifestyle that simply isn’t possible on a typical homesite.
